chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from al-Ṣaffār, from Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from Yaʿqūb ibn Shuʿayb, from Ḥarīz, or from one who narrated it from him, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام: The people of Kūfah narrate from ʿAlī عليه السلام that he used to command wudu (ablution) before ghusl from janabah.
He said: They have lied against ʿAlī عليه السلام. They did not find that in the Book of ʿAlī عليه السلام.
Allah, Exalted is He, said: “And if you are in a state of janabah, then purify yourselves.”

key_terms.الْجَنَابَةِ: state of major ritual impurity requiring ghusl
key_terms.كَذَبُوا: they lied or falsely attributed a statement
key_terms.كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ: the written record attributed to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: Is wudu (ablution) required before ghusl for janabah according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith rejects the report that Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام commanded wudu (ablution) before ghusl for janabah. It cites the Qur’anic command to purify oneself from janabah directly, indicating that ghusl itself fulfills the required ritual purification in this context.
